name: LeadFlow — Intake → Gemini Score → CRM Sync

nodes.name: LeadFlow: New Lead
nodes.notes: Copy this node's Production URL into N8N_WEBHOOK_URL on Vercel. POST /api/leads fire-and-forgets the flat lead JSON here after every insert.

nodes.name: Normalize Fields
nodes.notes: Flattens the payload, derives company/domain from the email when blank, and builds the Gemini request body. Edit LEADFLOW_BASE_URL here.

nodes.name: AI Score (Gemini)
nodes.notes: Credential: Header Auth with name `x-goog-api-key` and your Gemini key from aistudio.google.com/apikey. neverError is on so a Gemini outage still lets the CRM sync run on the app's own score.

nodes.name: Parse AI Result
nodes.notes: Falls back to the score the app already computed if Gemini fails, so a bad API response never downgrades a hot lead.

nodes.name: Upsert to GoHighLevel
nodes.notes: Upsert is idempotent on email — safe to re-run without creating duplicate contacts. Replace YOUR_GHL_LOCATION_ID in the Parse AI Result node.

nodes.name: Write Score → LeadFlow
nodes.notes: Neon has no REST layer, so the write-back goes through the app's own PATCH /api/leads/:id route.

nodes.name: Alert Sales (Slack)
nodes.notes: Replace with your Slack Incoming Webhook URL. Only fires for hot leads.

parameters.content:
## LeadFlow automation (Neon + Gemini)

`POST /api/leads` ▶ this webhook ▶ normalize ▶ **Gemini score** ▶ upsert to GoHighLevel ▶ write score back ▶ alert sales on hot leads.

**Before activating:**
1. Set `LEADFLOW_BASE_URL` in **Normalize Fields**.
2. Add a **Header Auth** credential named `x-goog-api-key` holding your Gemini key → attach to **AI Score**.
3. Add the **GoHighLevel OAuth2** credential and replace `YOUR_GHL_LOCATION_ID` in **Parse AI Result**.
4. Replace the Slack Incoming Webhook URL.
5. Copy this webhook's Production URL into `N8N_WEBHOOK_URL` on Vercel.

All HTTP bodies are built with `JSON.stringify`, so quotes or newlines in a lead's message can't break the request.
